nodes.label: Spring Boot Backend
nodes.rationale: Configured as alternate Maven entrypoint compiling shared sources from repo root to avoid source drift. Java source at ../src/main/java, resources at ../src/main/resources, tests at ../src/test/java.

nodes.label: Offline-First Sync Strategy
nodes.rationale: Family registration saves to SharedPreferences BEFORE attempting backend sync. Patients saved to SQLite. Auto-sync triggered on connectivity restore. Conflict detection supports choosing local vs server version.

nodes.label: Unidirectional Data Flow Pattern
nodes.rationale: User Interaction -> Event Handler -> ref.read(provider.notifier).method() -> AddPatientNotifier -> state.copyWith() -> Freezed immutable update -> Notify all watchers -> Rebuild affected widgets.

nodes.label: Conditional Rendering Logic
nodes.rationale: Pregnancy section shown only for Female gender. Address input hidden if using family address. Delete button hidden if only 1 patient. Disease grid disabled if privacy declined (Opacity 40% + IgnorePointer).

nodes.label: Dark Theme Color Scheme
nodes.rationale: Primary #14b8a6 (Teal) for active states, #f97316 (Orange) for privacy warnings, #ec4899 (Pink) for pregnancy, #ef4444 (Red) for delete. Backgrounds #0f1419 and #1f2937.

nodes.label: Riverpod vs React useState Mapping
nodes.rationale: React SPA with useState maps to Flutter ConsumerWidget with Riverpod StateNotifier. Props/state lifting maps to ref.watch()/ref.read(). Conditional JSX rendering maps to Dart if-statements in build methods. useEffect validation maps to computed providers.

nodes.label: Freezed copyWith vs JS Spread Operator
nodes.rationale: React uses spread operator {...obj, field: value} for immutable updates. Flutter uses Freezed-generated copyWith() for type-safe immutable state mutations.
